thesisSummary: Larchmere Immune Ventures is a seed-stage fund that starts companies around university immunology research, focusing on engineered immune cells (CAR T, TCR, adoptive cell therapy and persistence-enhancing methods) and immunomodulators (antibodies, cytokines, fusion proteins, small molecules) for both cancer immunotherapy and autoimmune/inflammatory/fibrotic disease. It targets three problems: cell therapy failure in solid tumors, reliance on broad immunosuppressants/steroids in lupus, systemic sclerosis and IBD, and the limited reach of current checkpoint inhibitors. It needs in vivo efficacy in at least one disease model (a provisional or PCT filing suffices), an exclusive worldwide university license with a committed inventor, and excludes diagnostics, research tools and screening platforms, devices/imaging, digital health, anti-infectives, animal health and agriculture.
